name: S11b_mit_supercloud_2021-08-11_bchydro_60mw
description: Constraint-test variant of S11_mit_supercloud_2021-08-11_bchydro, identical except the BC Hydro grid import is deliberately capped at 60 MW (below the 61.8 MW observed facility peak) to exercise import-limit behaviour; expect ~1.8 MW unserved during the largest bursts. Same MIT SuperCloud 2021-08-11 workload, no turbines, 18 MW / 14 MWh grid-forming BESS, diesel block configured but disabled (IMPL-S11-03). Cap value PROPOSED_HERE.

operating_cost_inputs.gas_price_usd_per_mmbtu_provenance: CITED: EIA U.S. Natural Gas Industrial Price, Aug 2025–Jul 2026 12-month mean $5.331/Mcf (https://www.eia.gov/dnav/ng/hist/n3035us3m.htm), divided by EIA 2025 average heat content 1,037 Btu/cf = 1.037 MMBtu/Mcf (https://www.eia.gov/tools/faqs/faq.php?id=45&t=5).
operating_cost_inputs.gas_price_basis_provenance: CITED: EIA heat-content conversion above; price is recorded on an HHV basis.
operating_cost_inputs.diesel_price_usd_per_gal_provenance: CITED: EIA U.S. on-highway No. 2 diesel retail, week of 2026-10-19, $6.276/gal, including taxes (https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel/). Off-road generator fuel may exclude road taxes. S11: US price retained from S10; a BC off-road diesel price has not been sourced (PROPOSED_HERE).
operating_cost_inputs.turbine_variable_om_usd_per_mwh_provenan: CITED proxy: EIA AEO2025 Capital Cost and Performance Characteristics, Table 1-2, Case 3, simple-cycle aeroderivative CTs, 4 × 54 MW; $5.70/MWh, 2023 dollars (https://www.eia.gov/analysis/studies/powerplants/capitalcost/pdf/capital_cost_AEO2025.pdf).
operating_cost_inputs.turbine_fixed_om_usd_per_kw_yr_provenanc: CITED proxy: EIA AEO2025 Capital Cost and Performance Characteristics, Table 1-2, Case 3, simple-cycle aeroderivative CTs, 4 × 54 MW; $9.56/kW-year, 2023 dollars; proxy for larger aeroderivative units.
operating_cost_inputs.turbine_start_cost_usd_per_start_provena: No cited non-fuel start-cost source; intentionally left null.
operating_cost_inputs.bess_degradation_usd_per_mwh_provenance: No cited degradation-cost source; intentionally left null.
operating_cost_inputs.unserved_energy_value_usd_per_mwh_proven: No cited unserved-energy value; intentionally left null.
operating_cost_inputs.currency_year: mixed: 2023 USD O&M; 2026 USD fuel prices
operating_cost_inputs.currency_year_provenance: CITED: EIA AEO2025 O&M proxy is 2023 dollars; fuel prices are US public prices observed in 2026. Values are not inflation-normalized.

provenance_s11.bess_reserve: bess_normal_dispatch_depth_fraction 0.25 PROPOSED_HERE (Lloyd ruling 2026-10-27, IMPL-S11-05 stopgap): per core/dispatch.py soc_floor_mwh, reserve = usable_mwh x (initial_soc_fraction - depth) = 14 x (0.95 - 0.25) = 9.8 MWh (SoC floor 0.70), about 33 min at the 18 MW rating; 3.5 MWh available for normal dispatch. Interim until DR-2026-10-27-GRID-MODE-BESS; no grid-charging path exists, so SoC will hold at the floor rather than recover.
